name: Card grid fill
oneLiner: a glass grid of content cards (the brand's screens as thumbnails, an avatar and skeleton lines, no copy) fills slot by slot, each card dropping out of depth into a dashed slot, faster and faster, while a chip counts them; the chip snaps to the accent when the grid is full and a light sweeps every card
say: when the speaker talks about volume or a body of work ("I've posted 300 videos", "we shipped a post every day for a year"): cut in on the number, set unit to what they made and total to the real number so the chip runs past the cards; the snap lands as they finish the sentence
